gemini.title: National Nature Reserves
gemini.abstract: National Nature Reserves is an authoritative dataset published by Natural England. It represents national nature reserves features using multipolygon geometry.
gemini.lineage: Published by Natural England as open environmental and conservation data. Loaded into Systra PostGIS database without transformation.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Primary-key identifier for records in national_nature_reserves.

columns.name: geom
columns.description: Spatial geometry of the represented feature.

columns.name: OBJECTID
columns.description: Source-system row identifier; useful internally but not guaranteed to remain stable between data releases.

columns.name: HYPERLINK
columns.description: URL of the corresponding record on the publisher's website.

columns.name: REF_CODE
columns.description: Code assigned by the source dataset.

columns.name: NAME
columns.description: Official or publisher-assigned name of the represented feature.

columns.name: GlobalID
columns.description: UUID-formatted identifier associated with the record; persistence across releases is not confirmed.
